== [[Cancelled Expansions]] ==
<div style="overflow:auto;">
[[File:SoTE-Skywalkers-Ad-DSII-Starter-Deck.webp|thumb|right|160px|Advertisement from the Death Star II Starter Deck rulebook]]
Decipher announced further original-trilogy sets after Death Star II. None of these shipped. The Death Star II Starter Deck rulebook advertised Shadows of the Empire and Skywalkers; ''After Death Star II'' on Decipher.com added Jedi Masters and Scoundrels. Reflections Gold was a later foil announcement.

* 33 &ndash; [[Shadows of the Empire]] (August 2000, 20 cards)
* 34 &ndash; [[Skywalkers]] (November 2000)
* 35 &ndash; [[Jedi Masters]] (February 2001)
* 36 &ndash; [[Scoundrels]] (September 2001)
* 37 &ndash; [[Reflections Gold]] (December 2001, 310 cards)
</div>
